answer: Agents register in the saffron state tree only after an SGX/TPM enclave emits a zero-knowledge attestation binding code, device key, and monotonic counter; the bridge contract verifies proofs and anchors accepted identities in the relic hash chain. Forging requires compromising distinct certified hardware or continuously provisioning silicon with unique keys, while bonds follow an O(N^2) curve and are irreversibly slashed on duplicate or invalid attestations.
